begin
  let g := λ y : α, (f y, y),

    unfold g,
    simp only [OrderHom.map_apply],

  {
    intro y,
    unfold g,
    exact le_rfl,
  },
  have hfixed : Function.fixedPoints g,
  {
    refine ⟨_, hg, hg'⟩,
  },
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := hfixed.exists,
  use p,
  rw Function.fixedPoint.def,
  rw Function.fixedPoint.def at hp,
  rw OrderHom.map_apply at hp,
  congr,
  exact hx,
end
